latestVersion.changelog:
Podcast Video Free — Initial Release

- Convert podcast audio (MP3, WAV) or video files (MP4, MOV) up to 500MB into video with waveform animation and captions—ideal for fast publishing to YouTube or social media.
- No complex editing required; describe your desired output and receive a ready-to-download 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with free 7-day API token (100 credits)–no account needed.
- Supports batch processing, editing, and iterative workflows within a session.
- Cloud rendering pipeline includes status updates, error handling, and credit management.
